resources.string: Enter your account email to request a password reset link.
If an account exists for %1$s, you will receive a password reset link. Check your inbox and spam folder. The link expires after 30 minutes and can only be used once.
We could not request a reset link. Check your connection and try again.
Choose a password with 8 to 72 characters, including at least one letter and one digit.
This reset link is not valid
The link may be missing, expired or already used. Request a new link to recover your account.
We could not update your password. Check your connection and try again.
You can now sign in with your new password.
Your password was updated, but we could not clear your previous session. Tap Sign in to try again.
